chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Moten band's first trip to New York and the Apollo
summary: After Fairyland Park the band played New York for six to eight weeks with twin pianos and was well received.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: After they finished the engagement at Fairyland Park, the Moten band had an engagement in New York City, where they did play at the Apollo Theatre. I imagine that they were in New York city six weeks or eight weeks and they did very well there. They liked the Kansas City style of music and the beat and the Kansas City bands at that time, which was known then as Kansas City jazz.
Basie was with that band then?
And they were using twin pianos in New York.
And they used twin pianos at Fairyland Park I understand?
And then what? This was the first time that Moten went to New York?
Right, and he took Basie with him and after the six weeks were up --
Do you know who their agent was in New York?
Do you remember where they played in New York?
No, I don't. It didn't seem important to me then, you know.
Well, that's understandable. Well after six weeks they came back to Kansas City?
About six or eight weeks, maybe two months.
Where did they go into then? They played around town?
They did. I think they mostly did one nighters. Around Lawrence, Kansas, you know, Topeka, Kansas City.
